notes_for_editor: The only source that names this tower is the FFLA index entry, which gives county, coordinates and status and nothing else. The Forest Lookouts site has no Texas page for Rocky Hill, and a ScholarWorks search result I checked was a different tower (Cyclone Hill). The story runs short of 120 words of body text because the evidence is thin; it was not padded. Other Rocky Hill pages in the Forest Lookouts cache were not used because they do not mention a Texas tower. Brief record check: name, county and coordinates match the index; no correction proposed. Next steps if pursued: the Cavallerano book's Angelina County entries and Angelina National Forest or Texas A&M Forest Service site records. Two WebSearch queries found no construction date, builder or height.
